title.suggested: Allen backs Al Neist in a wrestling challenge to Mike Mooney

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Tom Allen offered to back Al J. Neist against Mike Mooney in a lightweight wrestling match for $250 a side, saying no fight could be held around St. Louis.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Friday, St. Louis Post-Dispatch, January 11, 1895, page 5.

facts.fact: Allen offered to back Al J. Neist against Mike Mooney in a lightweight wrestling match, any style, for $250 a side, winner take all
Allen said no prizefight could be held around St. Louis, so he advised Neist to wrestle
facts.quote: There is no chance to pull off a fight in any kind of shape around St. Louis nowadays, however, and for that reason, I advised Neist to try and get Mooney to wrestle him.

notes: The current title says boxing is 'now illegal'; the article only says no fight could be pulled off around St. Louis.
